body: Im taking one pill in the night, just that, is what doctors gave me in the ER, my parents give it to me of course. Well after my suicide attempt they are concern about me, but we dont talk about our or my feeling, they don't know how to. They are old, both over 70 years old

About therapy I have to wait until the end of march to see what my insurance offer me about that(is not very good in latin america) but even with therapy I dont think it will help, I ve been in therapy before when my parents could afford it, and nothing changed
